name: Pacha New York
status_note: Open. Opened June 2026 on the former Brooklyn Mirage site. The official site lists the Open Air Season Closing on Sun Oct 18, 2026, then a 'Brooklyn Pacha Opening Party' on Nov 6 and indoor events through late Nov, with more listed into Dec. Secret NYC (Jun 2026) reported it was running on a temporary liquor license.

dress.detail: Brooklyn Magazine (Apr 2026) quoted the club's site: no beachwear (swimsuits, flip-flops, men's vests, bare torsos). The VIP area also bans shorts, sportswear, sneakers, sweatshirts and caps. The current official contact/FAQ page doesn't show a dress code.

cover.value: Ticketed. GA from ~$40-145 for most Oct-Nov 2026 nights (one headliner from $450). Backstage/VIP from ~$150-450. Late early-entry arrivals pay the difference to the door price.

getting_in.value: Buy tickets in advance on the official site; big headliner nights sell out. Backstage/VIP is booked on the site too. Staff run security checks at the door, and gum was confiscated on opening night.

hours.value: Event nights only. Most events run 10pm-4am (the open-air closing ran 8pm-1am). Check each event.

subway.value: L train. Jefferson St or Morgan Av are the nearby stops, roughly a 10-minute walk (check the walk time on a map). The venue also runs a shuttle (see the official Shuttle Information page).

skip_if: You want cheap or spontaneous: it's ticketed, with prices that climb by tier, and the biggest nights sell out.
You're after a small, intimate club: it's a mega-venue (Billboard estimated ~5,000 on the floor on opening night).
